*takes place after the fall of the republic* 

Asara had been travelling from planet to planet studying wildlife and looking for artifacts..  she knew the empire had prohibited it.. but she secretly loved jedi artifacts collecting old lightsabres or fragments of republic ships.. 

Her newest search had led her to tattoine where there was a rumour of an actual jedi in hiding.. obviously it was just a rumour.. but to her it was everything.. 

Once she arrived landing her replica jedi interceptor *yes shes so obsessed she built her own and paid thousands for a license* she decided to visit the canteen first and get a drink.. however she would find much more than just a drink there.. 

She sat down in one of the booths before noticing a hooded figure a few seats away from her... she didnt know why.. but they just felt off.. and under closer inspection she noticed.. a lightsaber! They were the jedi it had to be! 

Asara: *she quickly sat down next to them smiling brightly* oh my gosh your one of them arent you! *she lent in hugging their arm and whispering in their ear* if your a jedi then please follow me outside..  I really need to talk to you..  I promise I wont tell anyone about you just please come with me..
